document:
Suleiman the Magnificent
Suleiman I (Ottoman Turkish: سلطان سليمان اول‎ "Sultan Süleyman-ı Evvel"; Turkish: "I. Süleyman, Kanunî Sultan Süleyman "or" Muhteşem Süleyman" ; 6 November 1494 – 6 September 1566), commonly known as Suleiman the Magnificent in the West and Kanunî Sultan Süleyman (Ottoman Turkish: قانونى سلطان سليمان‎) (English: "The Lawgiver Suleiman") in his realm, was the tenth and longest-reigning sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1520 to his death in 1566. Under his administration, the Ottoman state ruled over 15 to 25 million people.
